goal: Create a multi-panel IP card, aspect ratio 3:4, with a festive yet tasteful character, suitable for printing on the back cover of surrounding manuals.

ip.name: Little ridge beast squatting
ip.tagline: Little guardians on the temple roof, accompany you for a leisurely stroll inside the exhibition
ip.personality: Curious, loves liveliness, a bit proud of traditional culture.
ip.brand_owner: Palace Museum cultural heritage · Youth guide and cultural creative subline (concept rehearsal).

mascot.form: Rounded small spine beast, egg-shaped body, short four legs, tail with wavy glass flame pattern; a gem blue dot on the forehead, a mini roof ridge and a silhouette of a kiss beast on the top of the head; no realistic beast bone structure, overall toy-like feel.
mascot.color_palette: Bright yellow, amber gold, royal blue, palace wall gray, with a small amount of vermilion embellishment
mascot.rendering: 2D cartoon thick coating, clear line edges, no strong 3D reflections

hero.content: Full body main image + vertical side ranking 'Little Spine Beast Squatting' + small text 'Palace Top Inspiration · Non-cultural Relic Body'
hero.background: Very light beige + repeated light cloud patterns, not overshadowing the main subject.

three_view.content: Three images in equal proportions: front / side / back arranged horizontally, with consistent perspective on the roof peak directly above the head and consistent curvature of the tail flame
three_view.label: FRONT / SIDE / BACK
